claim_boundary: Post-hoc analysis after the v1 outcome and power correction were known. It can refine interpretation and motivate the large-corpus design; it is not confirmatory evidence for a new mechanism.

order_invariant_signal.interpretation: Most measured cross-observer churn divergence is already present under arbitrary shared insertion orders. The data therefore motivate an order-invariant susceptibility question: which static local properties of an observer geometry predict expected churn per unit corpus mass, averaged over arrival orders? Chronology-specific arrival effects are not the next primary mechanism.

paired_curve_test.method: Paired within-document permutation of observer labels; statistic is the difference in Kaplan-Meier restricted mean survival time (RMST) through the full 92-added-document horizon. This tests the whole first-churn survival curve while respecting that both observers encode the same anchors.

baseline_density_check.metric: Baseline local density proxy = cosine similarity to the 5th nearest neighbor among the 24 initial documents, measured separately inside each observer's L2-normalized embedding geometry. Higher is denser.
baseline_density_check.interpretation_boundary: Post-hoc confound check only. L2 normalization removes vector-norm scale from cosine neighborhoods. The survival separation persists in every pooled density tercile, so a simple local-density explanation is not supported in this pilot. Embedding dimensionality remains inseparable from observer identity with only two models.

baseline_gap_descriptive.metric: cosine similarity gap between the 5th and 6th nearest neighbors among the 24 initial documents
baseline_gap_descriptive.claim_boundary: Descriptive only. Gap was already inspected in v1 and had unstable sign across observers; no post-hoc gap mechanism is inferred here.

large_corpus_measurement_contract.same_observer_control: Report a separately specified same-observer bootstrap/stability ceiling as a function of N. Because the encoders are deterministic, exact same-model same-gallery mKNN is identically 1 and must not be mislabeled as a seed-null; the perturbation/bootstrap operator must be frozen before the large-corpus run.
large_corpus_measurement_contract.decision: The static paper proceeds only if calibrated cross-model local alignment is scale-stable enough to interpret and remains materially below the frozen same-observer stability ceiling across relevant N and k.
